mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a recessionary labor market, which reduces earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month decline in the housing index (HOUST) signals broad demand contraction, which reduces earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of falling RSAFS and HOUST (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% combined with a 3-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a deepening labor market downturn, which reduces earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
